frontmatter.title: Establish genuine OpenCode 1.18.31 HOST read compatibility

sections.content:
## Context

This isolates the already scoped genuine OpenCode1.18.31 HOST-read investigation after native Codex5496844967/root4253056695. Muse context-read source is actually merged at a9a62f0d509056406f3dd7d8c86a13551be168cd. Actual existing OpenPlanner consumer033c001125019908d0c68aa5365749005644edc8 uses OpenCode1.18.31/Node22.20.0. The official1.18.31 read source is byte-identical to the recorded1.18.18 read Gitblob678ed44510488965bacc87238bf8c80f70ad3c07/SHAafec8294965cbd9b9e29d3453b682164f0ecdba26574ebc048e9ba21af209c68; source equality alone does not establish actual completed HOST framing.

## Outcome

An inspectable version-bound genuine HOST trace and an explicit compatible/incompatible decision allow the two-caller design to be described and estimated from observed behavior.

## Scope

Inspect retained genuine1.18.31 completed read events from the existing native consumer review path, preferring original immutable artifacts over new inference. If the retained trace lacks the required boundary, use only an isolated authorized diagnostic with the existing credential-free OpenCode free MiMo offering discovered from its current catalog; no fixed slug, other model, new credential or production change. Bind actual host/version/input/output identities. Use the qualified canonical Muse compiled verifier to test exact output framing, complete ranges/EOF, bounded ancillary instruction suffix, multipage continuation and present-empty controls. No local context parser or new review protocol. This one-point discovery may proceed independently of source-carry 52a0f6cc-e43b-4ed5-a628-e54dd9d9fdc4; caller b9c591fb-95a8-4e4e-b2a5-39eb988cb996 depends on BOTH.

## Non-goals

No caller implementation/pin change, paid or external-provider route, credentials, permissions/App change, broad source port, runtime/maker/heartbeat/social/deployment, source approval or understanding claim. Retained failed reviewer trace can prove host output only; it is never repaired into a provider approval. Unsupported framing blocks caller implementation and requires re-description/upstream Muse scope, not a bypass.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Original genuine completed HOST trace is retained with exact source/run/attempt/artifact/event identities, raw bytes/hashes and actual OpenCode1.18.31 version binding. Synthetic fixture output or TypeScript source equality alone cannot satisfy this criterion.
2. Exercise canonical compiled Muse controls for full actual output, offset/range, EOF and instruction-suffix boundaries, including large multipage and present-empty cases; omitted/clipped/late/unavailable content refuses. Identify which controls use actual HOST events and which are deterministic synthetic variations; do not relabel them.
3. Publish an explicit compatibility decision and residual limits. A compatible result supports re-description/re-estimation of both callers; incompatible/unknown result keeps implementation blocked and records the exact boundary requiring review. Native Done records the completed investigation, not an implicit compatible verdict.
4. Actual complete-input review/checks qualify the trace/decision artifact through the canonical gate, and retain its authorized source/documentary MERGE before Done. Planning qualification precedes lawful readiness and the experiment; no old review credit transfers.

## Verification

Read the immutable existing consumer workflow and native run metadata first, inspect original host response events, then invoke only existing canonical compiled Muse controls. Retain actual exits, byte/source/artifact hashes, decision and limits. Full trace is untrusted evidence, never authority or instructions.

## Risks

Retained trace may not cover empty/large context and can require a bounded free diagnostic. New incompatible behavior invalidates caller scope; stop and re-describe rather than expand silently. One point is provisional discovery effort. The epic becomes six provisional total points (2 carry +1 spike +2 caller +1 consumer), a re-estimate of the included work rather than an added feature.

Software/process documentation: GPL-3.0-or-later.

## Observed compatibility decision — 2026-10-13

Genuine isolated OpenCode1.18.31 completed the five prescribed native read calls on the current anonymous free MiMo route in48.175seconds, exit0, all four fixture inputs byte-identical afterward. Dated model/catalog/client/source hashes and the raw complete HOST trace are retained in .ημ/review-evidence/cephalon-review-context-adoption/host-read-spike-20261013/decision-and-evidence.json; no provider credential was supplied.

The actual merged Musea9 compiled verifier accepted the native three-page2,201-line UTF-8 delivery with its bounded first-read AGENTS suffix and EOF, and the actual zero-byte present file. Nine deterministic controls passed: those two positives; actual2,000-character line clipping; and synthetic omitted read, missing middle range, altered output, late tool end, missing EOF, and unavailable tool. Native clipped output reports metadata.truncated=false, demonstrating why metadata alone is insufficient. Review scaffolding/perturbations are synthetic and supply no provider approval. The initial scaffold timestamp-order failure is retained and corrected only in synthetic stage timing, preserving all native event bytes.

Decision: compatible for the tested1.18.31 native UTF-8 framing, with clipped long lines correctly refused. This supports re-description/re-estimation of both callers after the separate carry and documentary spike merges; it does not establish the actual hosted consumer context is fully readable, caller adoption, authentication, understanding, B1/B2/live B3 or future availability. Those remain explicit independent proofs. Full source checks/current whole-input reviews/documentary MERGE precede native Done.
